summary.en-US: Listen to YouTube and YouTube Music without downloading video. Audio-only playback saves battery and data, with background and lock-screen play, ad and telemetry blocking, segment skipping, loudness normalization, EQ, and audio download.

description.en-US:
YouTube Audio is a major overhaul and refresh, rebuilt from the ground up to do one thing beautifully: play YouTube and YouTube Music as audio only. It points the player at a direct audio stream and stops the video download at its source, so your battery and mobile data last far longer while the sound keeps playing. The native player and its controls stay exactly where you expect them.

What you get:
- Audio only, video bytes gone. Same controls, far less battery and data.
- Background and lock-screen play. Lock the phone or switch tabs and the audio carries on, with your usual OS media controls.
- Ghost mode. Ads and tracking pings are blocked before they leave your browser, quietly, by default.
- Skip the boring bits. SponsorBlock-style auto-skip past sponsor reads and off-topic intros. Only a tiny hash ever leaves your machine to look them up.
- YouTube Music, leveled up. Even out loud-and-quiet tracks with loudness normalization and shape the sound with a 5-band equalizer.
- Save a track. Download the current audio as a single, tidy .m4a.
- Tidy up the page. Optionally hide Shorts, recommendations, comments, thumbnails, or channel pictures, cap the quality, or switch off autoplay-next.

Built for you, not for data:
- Logged out, always. It never needs, reads, or touches your YouTube account.
- No accounts, no analytics, no phone-home. Requests for the media you play go to YouTube and its media servers, without your cookies; nothing is stored or shared with anyone else. If you turn on the SponsorBlock lookup, a 4-character hash goes to the SponsorBlock API, and nothing at all if you leave it off.
- Falls back gracefully, and lightly. Live streams, made-for-kids, age-restricted, or members-only videos keep playing on normal YouTube at the lowest quality, and YouTube Music switches to the song version when there is one. No broken playback, ever.

Firefox 128 and up, on desktop and Android. The essentials are on out of the box; the rest waits until you ask.

release_notes.en-US:
A major overhaul and refresh: YouTube Audio is rebuilt around one job - clean, reliable audio-only playback on YouTube and YouTube Music, on Firefox desktop and Android.

What is new and better:
- Rock-solid audio-only. Toggle it off and you land back on the video at the exact spot you were listening to, playing or paused, even if you flip it on and off in a hurry.
- Per-tab control. Switch audio-only for just the tab in front of you from the popup, the in-player button, or Alt+Shift+A on desktop; the global setting stays the default everywhere else.
- Reliable on Android. Audio-only holds through YouTube's player changes on Firefox for Android, including a fix for a mid-playback position reset.
- Honest status. The popup shows the real state of the current video, so you always know when something has fallen back to normal YouTube.
- Lighter and smoother. Changing one setting now reloads only what that setting touches, and a rare case that could make YouTube feel sluggish was tracked down and fixed.
- Friendly to your other extensions. If another extension has already patched the player, this one now adopts and chains with it instead of fighting it.
- Playback that stays awake. YouTube's are-you-still-there pause no longer interrupts audio-only listening, including long background sessions.
- Nicer in the player. The audio-only button matches YouTube's own controls in size and style, and audio mode shows the track artwork instead of a black rectangle.
- Cleaner downloads. One track, one well-behaved .m4a file, no pile of stray files.
- Tidy up the page, if you want. Hide Shorts, recommendations, comments, thumbnails, or channel pictures, cap the quality, or switch off autoplay-next.
- Nothing extra at install. The SponsorBlock lookup and the file-download ability now ask for their access only when you switch each one on. Until you accept the data notice, the popup points you straight to it.
- Cleans up when switched off. Disabling or updating the extension takes its tweaks back out of pages that are already open and hands playback back to YouTube.

Ghost mode (ad and telemetry blocking) and loudness normalization are on out of the box; SponsorBlock-style skipping, the equalizer, and the page tidy-ups are one switch away when you want them. Everything stays logged out. Requests for the media you play go to YouTube and its media servers without your cookies; nothing is stored or shared with anyone else, and the optional SponsorBlock lookup sends only a 4-character hash.
